explanation: States that some Sidon set has normalized upper density exactly 1/√2. Krückeberg showed 1/√2 is attainable, i.e. ≥ 1/√2. Exact equality also follows, either from his construction or by thinning: subsets of Sidon sets are Sidon, and the limsup can be lowered to any target by deleting elements. So the statement is true and faithful.
